title: Hybrid semantic retrieval and reranking
summary: I am studying how BM25 lexical retrieval, sentence embeddings and reciprocal rank fusion combine candidate documents. I want practical retrieval and cross encoder ranking references.

title: Chrome Manifest V3 extension permissions
summary: I am building a browser extension popup that reads the active tab after a user action. I need scripting permissions, browser storage and safe network requests without reading every page in the background.

title: Python API validation and deployment
summary: I want to deploy a FastAPI service using typed Pydantic request models and ASGI middleware. HTTP client timeouts and Uvicorn worker deployment should be configured explicitly.

title: Kafka consumer duplicate event processing
summary: An at least once Kafka consumer receives duplicate events after retries. I need idempotency keys, transactions and database unique constraints to avoid applying business effects twice.

title: API overload upstream failures and observability
summary: A service needs concurrency limits, load shedding, circuit breakers and cache TTLs when an upstream dependency becomes slow. Metrics and traces should expose latency without sensitive labels.

title: Secure browser extension and API authentication
summary: The extension must prevent unsafe DOM rendering and avoid server side request forgery. A backend should verify access token signatures, issuer, audience and scopes. Public clients need OAuth PKCE.

title: Extractive document summarization and text features
summary: I want an extractive summary and keywords from a text article without generating new claims. Compare TextRank graph ranking with TF IDF sparse features and simple lexical information retrieval baselines.

title: Reproducible service deployment and tests
summary: The application needs a locked Python dependency graph, automated unit and integration tests, CI workflows and a small secure container image. Autoscaling should follow measured capacity rather than guesswork.
